scope.title: Experimental Task A: Pendulum
scope.note: The booklet runs Tasks A, B and C. This extract contains the six Task A core pages, with a separate original rough-work page as a companion. Shared rules and separate yellow answer sheet are outside this extract.

translation.fonts: Original visible English/math faces where retained. Embedded Noto Serif KR and Noto Sans KR for translated Hangul, using matching serif/sans styling.
translation.math: Private replay-identical source mapping identifies native Cambria glyphs. Native outlines, positions of displayed equations, script sizes, and fraction paths verified.

qa.font_note: One unused embedded source font, covering two invisible spaces only, was pruned. Originally embedded visible font programs retained.
